Smooth crisp cartoon ink and restrained cel shading matching the reference illustration; NOT pixel art, not a 3D toy. Exactly 16 full-body sprites in a strict 4 columns by 4 rows grid, equally spaced, each isolated with generous empty transparent gutters. No labels, no grid lines, no text, no scenery, NO cast ground shadows. Same scale, consistent head/body proportions and foot baseline, no overlap across cells. MOB TETSU: same exact cute round black mouthless face, very large round gold glasses with black eyes and white catchlights, black cat-ear hood and black/white HORIZONTAL striped prisoner sweatshirt and trousers, white-toe black shoes, twisted rope diagonally across torso. Row4 DJ at an unseen waist-height console: both hands lowered in front, left hand works left deck, right hand works right deck, both hands hover relaxed over console. NO physical props or furniture drawn: book, broom, watering can and decks rendered separately by game. All poses articulate hands clearly and retain full character design and original outfit. No lettering or extraneous action marks.
